Definition: contracted for Latin ampliatus (enlarged); Amplias, a Roman Christian:--Amplias.
BiblicalUsage: Amplias is named once, in Paul's greetings at the end of Romans: 'Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.' That is all the Bible says of him — a Christian in Rome whom Paul loved, and whose name has been read in churches ever since, and though tradition says he was one of the seventy, Scripture itself gives us only the greeting.
TheologicalSignificance: One greeting is enough to tell me what mattered: Paul called him beloved in the Lord, and that is the whole of his story in Scripture. I believe God remembers His people by name even when history forgets everything else about them.
